extName.message: Picture-in-Picture Unlocker – PiP on any video

extDescription.message: Unlocks Picture-in-Picture on every video. Built for Crunchyroll (player inside an iframe), works on any site.

optModeList.message: Only on the sites listed below

optModeExcept.message: On every site, except the ones listed below

optSitesHint.message: One domain per line. Subdomains are included automatically (crunchyroll.com also covers static.crunchyroll.com). Already-open pages need a reload.
